Subject: Quick recap & next steps from today's call — data isolation needs

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Call recap (high-level)
- Primary requirement: strong data isolation for models serving production PII workloads.
- Compliance: SOC 2 + audit logs required; FinSecure team will need evidence and a technical walkthrough.
- Deployment preference: leaning toward Private VPC or on-prem; open to Dedicated if VPC controls satisfy your security team.
- KMS/CMEK required for encryption at rest, and strict egress controls.

Open/clarifying questions we promised to check:
1) Do you need on-prem deployment or will a customer-managed VPC (no shared networking with other customers) be acceptable?
2) Any hard requirements around network egress (e.g., no external internet access from serving nodes)?
3) Which teams should be involved in the technical kickoff (infosec, cloud infra, network)?

Next steps
- I attached our SOC 2 report and a suggested network diagram for a Private VPC setup.
- Proposed: schedule a 60-min technical kickoff with Mateo (CC'd) + your infra lead to map peering and KMS integration. Can you share 2 slots next week?
- I'll also open a HubSpot deal and share an initial SOW draft for timeline & pricing.

If it helps, short summary: Dedicated = reserved capacity in our infra (isolated GPU pools, but still a Redwood-managed network). Private VPC = customer-managed network and optional on-prem package for full air-gap. I'll lay out exact differences in the technical doc for your security team.

—Marissa

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the succinct summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- FinSecure processes highly sensitive financial data; our compliance team prefers minimal trust boundary. Ideally we want no possibility of data leaving our VPC or being stored on shared storage.
- Preferred option: Private VPC with customer-controlled networking (no shared subnets). On-prem is acceptable but may extend timeline.
- KMS/CMEK: must be customer-managed keys; we cannot use vendor-managed keys.
- Auditability: we need comprehensive per-request logs, retention for 2 years, and plaintext-free backups.

Can you confirm if Redwood's Private VPC option: 1) supports CMEK (customer-managed keys), 2) ensures no shared storage, and 3) provides the level of audit logs above?

Also, could you send over the SOC2 report and any architecture diagrams you mentioned?

Thanks — Samantha

Hi Samantha — great questions. Answers below and attached the SOC2 report + a proposed Private VPC network diagram. I also attached a draft SOW for timeline/estimate.

Short answers first:
1) CMEK: yes — our Private VPC offering supports customer-managed keys (we integrate with AWS KMS / GCP CMEK / on-prem HSMs). Keys remain under your control and rotations/ACLs are managed by your KMS.
2) Shared storage: Private VPC and Private On-Prem options do not use Redwood shared multi-tenant object stores for model inputs/outputs. All customer data is stored in your VPC or customer-managed storage. No customer data is retained in our shared tenant storage.
3) Audit logs: we produce per-request logs (request metadata, timestamps, model version, token counts) and can ship logs to your SIEM/Cloud Logging endpoint. Retention/archival policies are configurable; we can meet a 2-year retention requirement via log export to your S3/GCS bucket.

Dedicated vs Private VPC — practical guidance for FinSecure:
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools and isolated compute, but networking and some storage may still be Redwood-managed. Good when you need predictable throughput with faster onboarding.
- Private VPC: customer-managed networking, CMEK, no shared storage; best fit when your security/compliance requires full control of network and storage. On-prem option available for air-gapped deployments but will add ~8–12 weeks to timeline vs Private VPC.

Proposed next steps:
- Technical kickoff: Mateo will run the session to map VPC peering, routing, KMS setup, and log export. Can we do 60 minutes on either Tue 6/30 10–11am PT or Wed 7/1 2–3pm PT? Please confirm preferred slot and your infra contact.
- I attached: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2025.pdf and FinSecure_network_diagram.png (example topology).
- I'll push the SOW draft into HubSpot and share the link once updated.

Let me know if you want a short write-up comparing the two options tailored to your procurement team.

—Marissa
